evaluations.reason: The exact-price blocker has cleared. Rice caught at least six passes in six of eight 2025 games and had six catches on nine targets against Denver despite only 38 yards. FantasyPros documents a 26.2% target share and 31.9% first-read share, while Football Nation independently prefers O5.5 receptions. Denver is a difficult efficiency matchup, so PRIME deliberately discounts the raw recent hit rate and uses a conservative 55% fair probability rather than extrapolating 75%. At -102, the wager clears the minimum price-adjusted edge; do not chase worse than -110 or a move to 6.5 without recalculation.
